intro: Interview mode. Pick a question and I'll answer with Santiago's words.
draft: Draft: this answer will be replaced by Santiago's own words.

items.a: Because it's where the corporate clients I work with are, and because it brings identity, infrastructure and Microsoft 365 together on a single plane. That lets me solve problems end to end, not piece by piece.

items.q: What was your biggest technical challenge?
items.a: Automating the disaster recovery test. It went from about two hours of manual work to 45 minutes, with controls to avoid touching production and a report as evidence. The hard part wasn't the script: it was defining the recovery order and getting the team to trust the result.

items.q: How do you work with AI?
items.a: I use it to go faster, not to decide. I work with Claude Code, my own skills and MCP integrations, and every change goes through my review. I built ai-env, an open source harness where control is separated from execution.

items.q: How do you explain technical matters to the business?
items.a: I translate risk into cost and into a decision. Instead of talking about RPO and RTO, I show how much each minute of downtime costs and what needs to be approved to reduce it.

items.q: Where do you want to go?
items.a: From cloud to product: building tools on top of the cloud that a team uses every day, and taking ownership end to end, from the problem to operations.
